I hold a Ph.D. in forest sciences and work at the Czech University of Life Sciences Prague. My research sits between conservation biology, sustainability and macroecology, and much of it ends up as code: R packages, data pipelines and web tools for exploring spatial biodiversity data.

I use GitHub as my portfolio and playground, and I try to publish the tools and tutorials I write along the way.

My full curriculum vitae is available [here](https://gortegasolis.github.io/cv/).
